newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - United Dental started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - United Dental started.

text.p: Piper Jafray said on Monday it initiated coverage of United Dental Corp with a buy rating and a 12-month price target of between $21 and $23 per share.
-- Analyst John Penshorn said his 1997 earnings estimate was $0.38 per share and his 1998 estimate was $1.14 per share.
-- "Of all the publicly-traded dental HMOs, United Dental is the furthest along in creating a nationwide product offering," he said. It also had the highest growth rates in the sector, he said.
-- United Dental shares were off 3/8 at 14-3/4.
